description: Assert zero deleted plaintext/content through authority default/history policy, FTS, vector, graph, trace, inspector, cache, export, logs, snapshots, and stale windows after reconciliation.
testSection: Section 7 — Deletion residue: zero deleted content through all read paths after hard_delete + reconciliation

tests.description: Authority default-policy read (state=active) returns zero rows after hard_delete + reconciliation.
History read (active-only gate) exposes zero deleted records; deleted state is 'deleted' not 'active'.
FTS5 search returns zero hits for unique token in deleted record content; memories_fts row is gone.
tests.assertionsSummary: fts_hits_after=0; memories_fts row count for deleted memory_id=0

tests.description: Vector index (mem_vectors) has zero rows for deleted memory id after hard_delete + reconciliation.
tests.assertionsSummary: vec_after=0 in mem_vectors for deleted id

tests.description: BFS graph traversal returns no path through entity whose relationship has truth_state='deleted'.
tests.assertionsSummary: neighbor C not reachable via B→C with truth_state=deleted; B reachable via A→B with active relationship

tests.description: Trace injected-items join on memories.state=active returns zero after hard_delete.
tests.assertionsSummary: injected_active=0 (trace_items JOIN memories WHERE state=active returns zero rows for deleted ID)

tests.description: graph_revision advances after delete; any cache keyed by pre-delete revision is stale; active-memory count for new cache is zero.
Export active-only query returns zero rows for deleted record; total exportable count is zero.
Audit record payloads contain no raw plaintext of deleted memory content; only governance metadata.
tests.assertionsSummary: zero audit_records contain the unique plaintext token; audit records exist (governance metadata only)

tests.description: Combined end-to-end scenario: FTS, vector, graph, trace seeded; hard_delete + reconcile; zero residue across all 9 read paths verified in one test.
tests.assertionsSummary: authority_default=0, fts_hits=0, vec_rows=0, graph_hits=0, trace_injected=0, export=0, audit_plaintext=0

methodology: Real SQLite in-memory databases; no mocks; synchronous hard_delete + reconciliation (FTS purged in-tx via delete_fts_in_tx, vectors purged via Lifecycle::hard_delete async step, graph filtered via truth_state guard in entity_neighbors_v2); all assertions made post-delete before any new state changes.
reviewNote: Owner self-review accepted per dev-context.md (single-developer pre-production repository).
nonNegotiablesVerified: Zero deleted content through any default read path after reconciliation
Tests use real SQLite in-memory (no mocks)
FTS purged synchronously inside the authority transaction (delete_fts_in_tx)
Vectors purged in the async reconciliation step after commit
Graph traversal filters out deleted truth_state relationships in entity_neighbors_v2
Audit records contain no deleted plaintext content
